design_generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single approved-design candidate for a premium pixel-art game character, to guide later native Pixelorama drawing and sword animation.
Primary request: ONE exceptionally appealing full-body medieval knight character, in a relaxed but alert ready stance, three-quarter view facing right. Original richly designed adventure-game hero, polished and memorable at small sprite size, adult proportions with modest stylization around five heads tall. Not a crude geometric mannequin.
Design: beautiful layered cool SILVER STEEL plate armor over dark charcoal chainmail and leather, rounded articulated pauldrons, fitted breastplate with a raised central ridge, small brass clasps and trim, segmented elbow plates, convincing gauntlets, overlapping tassets and greaves, complete sturdy armored boots. A dark teal split tabard with a small simple embroidered golden sun emblem, warm burgundy shoulder cape with cream lining, leather belt with small practical pouch. A refined closed medieval bascinet helmet with expressive dark eye-slit and lifted brow ridge, tiny discreet brass crest, NOT a futuristic helmet or glowing robot face.
Pose: feet planted apart with believable weight, both arms and hands visible. Near gauntlet holds a complete elegant straight steel longsword in a calm low guard, diagonally down to the right. Blade tip, full blade, crossguard, grip and pommel all clearly visible with margin; far gauntlet is held near waist and reads as a separate hand. Cape falls behind shoulders with two or three readable cloth folds, no wild wind. Silhouette clearly separates the limbs, cape and sword. No shield so the armor and second arm remain visible.
Pixel craft: authentic beautifully authored 16/32-bit era pixel art, designed on a 128x128 logical canvas with deliberate square pixel clusters and hard stepped contours, shown at an exact integer magnification. Sophisticated volume from shaped color clusters: cool reflected blue in steel shadows, small warm brass highlights, carefully grouped cloth folds, readable solid forms. No numerical palette cap. Crisp pixel drawing, not smooth painted concept art covered in pixel texture. No blurry antialiasing, no airbrushed gradients, no scattered one-pixel noise, no 3D render.
Composition: ONE character only, entire head to boot soles and entire sword visible, balanced centered layout on genuinely transparent alpha. Occupy roughly 75 percent of canvas height; generous transparent padding on every side including sword tip and cape hem. No floor, shadow, scenery, colored backdrop, frame, inset, label, numbers, typography, logo or watermark. This is one detailed single-pose design reference, not an animation sheet and not multiple views.

animation_generation_prompt:
Create a WIDE TWO-TO-ONE contact sheet containing EIGHT SMALL SEPARATE pixel-art knight sprites on real transparency, FOUR columns and TWO rows. Use the reference solely for the same beautiful knight design and pixel-art rendering: silver layered armor, brass trim, teal gold-sun tabard, burgundy cream-lined cape, longsword. The sprites must be much SMALLER within their cells than a normal full-body illustration.
CRITICAL SPACING: Imagine eight equal square cells. Every COMPLETE sprite INCLUDING ENTIRE SWORD and cape must fit INSIDE THE CENTRAL 70 PERCENT of its own cell. Leave a completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTER of at least 15 PERCENT on EVERY EDGE OF EVERY CELL. Knight body itself only40PERCENT of cellheight, boots at78PERCENT of cellheight. Each sword points only into EMPTY SPACE INSIDE THE SAME CELL. Absolutely no sword, cape or foot may touch or cross a cell boundary, no silhouettes overlapping neighboring sprites. If the blade is horizontal, shorten apparent sword perspective or make the whole knight smaller to fit. Keep identical character scale across all eight cells. No visible grid or labels.
Eight frames in reading order: 1 neutral low guard; 2 crouched windback sword upperleft behind shoulder; 3 sword raised overhead; 4 forward descending cut sword upperright; 5 strike fully extended horizontalright; 6 follow-through sword lowerright; 7 recovering diagonal guard; 8 low guard near initialpose. Feet planted with believable joint movement, fararm naturallybalancing, cape reacting to attack. Same hand grips same blade throughout. All armor/head/hands/boots/sword complete, no slash trails.
Genuine crisp16/32bit fantasy game pixelart; deliberate squareclusters and readable materialvolume. No numericalpalettecap. Not smoothpaintedhighresolutionconceptart. Design reference stays attractive, platedarmorandclothcleanlyshaded. Onefigurepercell exactly8figures. Real transparentalpha, no background/scenery/floor/shadow/lettering/watermark. Output wide2:1sheet, not a single large figure.
